title: senna armata
intro: Senna armata, commonly known as Mexican senna, is a plant species belonging to the legume family and is widely distributed in the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Mexican senna include its use as a natural laxative, helping to regulate bowel movements and alleviate symptoms of constipation. The therapeutic actions of Mexican senna include its cathartic properties, which stimulate bowel contractions and relieve flatulence, making it a popular remedy for gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents of Mexican senna include anthraquinone glycosides, such as emodin and aloe-emodin, which are responsible for its laxative and therapeutic effects.
